title: Kamishiro Rui — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Two weeks until Rui's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu, Nene.
Mind helping me put the props away?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
Rui, the background curtain's all rolled up over there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. I just have to take it around back, yes? We should be set here, so please go lend Tsukasa a hand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rui, Rui☆
We picked up all the flowers we made go pop-pop and fly around♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku, Len.
Now, can you help me by putting them in this bag?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line:
Okay!
O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Len...?
You seem anxious. Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, um... It's nothing!
It's just... There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me? How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So... It's almost your birthday, right?
I was wondering if there's anything you want to do to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My birthday? Yes, it's a week after next, but I'd completely forgotten since our next show's also just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: *Stare*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There actually is something I'd really like to do for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There is...?!
Like what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just once, I'd like to invite all of my friends over to my house for a big birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I wanna celebrate too, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I'd love to have you all over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, we couldn't help but overhear that you may or may not want to throw a birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Something about inviting all your friends over to your house too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something about...? You heard everything while pretending to put the props away, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Operation Eavesdrop 'n' Prop Clean Up failed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How could this have happened...?!
Even after we asked Miku and Len to help us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course he figured out what was going on. I mean, the way you were staring at him was a dead giveaway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see... That explains why Len seemed so anxious. He was asked to draw out some answers from me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You know you could've just asked me directly without having to go through all this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be honest, we weren't expecting you to say anything about inviting your friends over for a party at your house. It seemed too ordinary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's about as ordinary as it gets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, you're okay with just that?
Now that our plan's been foiled, please feel free to ask us for anything. You don't have to hold back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! We mean it! Anything!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, you two, but why would I now choose to start holding anything back from all of you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is genuinely what I wish to do.
A perfectly ordinary birthday party like you'd see anywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If Rui's saying that's what he wants to do, then I say why not? I live right next door too, so why don't I bring over some games we can all play?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, good idea!
Much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I guess we're going with a perfectly ordinary party...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means we'll need candles for the cake, party goods and snacks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll bring over some decorations and yummy snacks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, and we'll make sure to get everything ready so that we can celebrate with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's start by asking KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, good call!
Let's go ask him♪
Two weeks later
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...?
From Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Rui, you're still up, right?
Happy birthday!!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already past midnight...
When did that happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Got any fun plans for today?
If you're gonna do something at school, I'll make sure to stop by!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I won't be doing anything at school.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Instead, I'll be having a simple party with my fellow troupe members and everyone who's helped us along the way.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Really?!
A simple party, huh? That sounds nice!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Good for you, Rui.
Have lots of fun, okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Yes, I plan to.
Thank you, Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Everyone have their poppers ready?
Also, how are the candles on the cake looking?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, they're all set.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We're ready over here too!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like we're all eager to get started.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Of course we are! We've been waiting two weeks for this♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let us commence our celebration! First, we will begin by wishing Rui a happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, lemme hit the lights♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, without further ado!
